settings.title: Settings
settings.sessdataHelp: Copy SESSDATA from your browser cookies. Required for scraping: Bilibili returns HTTP 412 to requests without a logged-in session.
settings.proxyHelp: HTTP proxy addresses, one per line. Anonymous requests rotate across them.
settings.refreshWindowHelp: Refresh only the most recent 30–50 videos on each automatic or manual stats capture.
settings.dataHelp: Clears the preferences this browser has stored. Fetched data on the server is untouched.
settings.clearConfirm: This clears the theme, language and other preferences stored in this browser and reloads the page. Fetched creator libraries stay on the server.

query.uidHelp: The number in the uploader's URL, e.g. 546195 in space.bilibili.com/546195.
query.rangeInvalid: The start date cannot be later than the end date.
query.fetchFailed: Could not start the fetch. Check the UID and that the backend is running.
